observations: Author example filters the continuous record before epoching, with .5-40 Hz bandpass and 49-51 Hz bandstop.
No minphase or explicit filter-order option is supplied.
Inspected upstream implementation defaults to minphase=0 and labels that branch zero-phase, non-causal.
interpretation: A chronological index split of these processed epochs does not by itself establish prediction using only samples available by each decision time. This is an information-access requirement, not evidence that authors leaked target labels or that unknown physiological event boundaries exist.
limitations: The sample script is not a complete versioned processing manifest for every published MAT.
Exact EEGLAB/firfilt versions and future support of the published MAT are not established.
No measured accuracy inflation, source-code execution, or new model fitting.
Continuous filtering is a standard offline analysis choice; it must match the declared intended use.
admissible_next_routes: Describe use of published MAT as retrospective offline evaluation and do not claim strict online deployment.
For a strict prefix/decision-time claim, build and verify an explicit raw-signal pipeline with fixed available context and latency; separate choices for filtering, calibration and query access.
download_note: Sizes are from the archive inventory, not new downloads. Only previously cached subject-1 full MAT and waveform fragments are available locally.
